db:select.doc:name: Select User
db:select.db:sql: SELECT user_id, name, email, date_of_birth, biological_sex, height_cm, weight_kg, activity_baseline, daily_caloric_target, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE user_id = :userId AND deleted_at IS NULL

db:select.doc:name: Select User Goal
db:select.db:sql: SELECT goal_id, user_id, goal_type, goal_direction, target_value, target_unit, is_primary, is_active, set_at, achieved_at FROM user_goals WHERE user_id = :userId

db:select.doc:name: Select Conditions
db:select.db:sql: SELECT condition_id, user_id, condition_type, management_status, diagnosed_at, notes, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM user_conditions WHERE user_id = :userId

db:select.doc:name: Select Dietary Constraints
db:select.db:sql: SELECT constraint_id, user_id, constraint_type, constraint_value, severity, is_active, created_at FROM dietary_constraints WHERE user_id = :userId

db:select.doc:name: Select User Preference
db:select.db:sql: SELECT preference_id, user_id, insight_frequency, preferred_wearable_metrics, preferred_nutrition_metrics, typical_breakfast_time, typical_lunch_time, typical_dinner_time, typical_sleep_time, target_sleep_duration_hrs, units_system, created_at, updated_at, insight_generation_mode, timezone FROM user_preferences WHERE user_id = :userId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import * from dwl::transforms --- { userId: vars.user[0].user_id, name: vars.user[0].name, email: vars.user[0].email, dateOfBirth: vars.user[0].date_of_birth, biologicalSex: vars.user[0].biological_sex, heightCm: vars.user[0].height_cm, weightKg: vars.user[0].weight_kg, activityBaseline: vars.user[0].activity_baseline, dailyCaloricTarget: vars.user[0].daily_caloric_target, createdAt: vars.user[0].created_at, updatedAt: vars.user[0].updated_at, goals: transformGoal(vars.user_goal) , conditions: transformConditions(vars.user_conditions) , constraints: transformConstrains(vars.dietary_constraints), preferences: transformPreferences(vars.user_preference) }

db:select.doc:name: Select User Id
db:select.db:sql: SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE (user_id = :userId OR email = :email) AND deleted_at IS NULL

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var conditionType = vars.condition.conditionType default vars.existingCondition[0].condition_type var request = vars.condition default vars.existingCondition[0] var diabetesStatus = ["monitoring", "diet_controlled", "medication_managed", "in_remission"] var commonStatus = ["monitoring", "diet_controlled", "medication_managed"] --- { isValidConditionPayload: if (conditionType == "type2_diabetes") (diabetesStatus contains request.managementStatus) else (commonStatus contains request.managementStatus), }

validation:is-true.doc:name: Condition Status is Valid
validation:is-true.message: #["Invalid $(vars.condition.conditionType default vars.existingCondition[0].condition_type) condition configuration. Verify the management status."]

logger.doc:name: Payload Is Valid
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var logMessage ='Validation Complete' var userId = { userId: vars.userId, isValid: vars.isValid.isValidConditionPayload, } import buildLog from dwl::log --- buildLog("INFO",logMessage,userId, vars.correlationId , "validate-conditions-payload")]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/java var existing = vars.existingGoal[0] var patch = vars.goal var current = { goalType: existing.goal_type, goalDirection: existing.goal_direction, targetValue: existing.target_value, targetUnit: existing.target_unit }
var request = if (vars.user.goalType != null) vars.user else { goalType: existing.goal_type, goalDirection: patch.goalDirection default existing.goal_direction, targetValue: patch.targetValue default existing.target_value, targetUnit: patch.targetUnit default existing.target_unit } var weightDirections = ["lose", "gain", "maintain"] var commonDirections = ["improve", "maintain"] var noTarget = request.targetValue == null and request.targetUnit == null --- { isValidWeightPayload: if (request.goalType == "weight_management") (weightDirections contains request.goalDirection) and request.targetValue != null and request.targetValue > 0 and request.targetUnit == "kg" else null,
isValidAthleticPayload: if (request.goalType == "athletic_performance") (commonDirections contains request.goalDirection) and noTarget else null,
isValidChronicConditionPayload: if (request.goalType == "chronic_condition_management") (commonDirections contains request.goalDirection) and noTarget else null,
isValidWellnessPayload: if (request.goalType == "general_wellness") (commonDirections contains request.goalDirection) and noTarget else null,
isValidSleepPayload: if (request.goalType == "sleep_improvement") (commonDirections contains request.goalDirection) and (noTarget or ( request.targetValue != null and request.targetValue > 0 and request.targetUnit == "hours" ) ) else null,
isValidEnergyPayload: if (request.goalType == "energy_optimization") (commonDirections contains request.goalDirection) and noTarget else null }
